Class Keyboard

java.lang.Object
awtzero.Keyboard
All Implemented Interfaces:
KeyListener, EventListener
public class Keyboard extends Object implements KeyListener
Keyboard class to handle keyboard input. It is recommended to use the enums in Key.java for key codes.
